verdict: Bull: chip stocks at 52-week highs, HBM/DRAM still rising (Q3 +13-18% QoQ), AMD MI400/Helios launched, MRVL Investor Day Oct 6 is a near-term catalyst, hyperscaler capex above baseline at $725-775B.
body_md:
## Fresh Developments (Last 24-72h)

**Memory / DRAM pricing (Signal 1 — moderating bull):** TrendForce Q3 2026 conventional DRAM contract prices came in at **+13–18% QoQ** (server DRAM) and **+15–20% QoQ** (PC DRAM, revised up). NAND +10–15% QoQ. Gains are clearly moderating from Q1's ~95% and Q2's ~60% surges, but still positive — the high-base effect and consumer demand ceiling are biting. TrendForce also raised Q4 2026 DRAM forecasts, suggesting pricing holds into year-end.

**HBM4 ramp / capacity (Signal 2 — mixed):** No fresh Oct 2026 correction announcement. Supply-side: Micron adding 60K HBM wafers/mo by year-end (→100K total, ~doubling); Samsung targeting 250K/mo (+47%). All three suppliers scaling simultaneously — baseline correction-after-2026 thesis remains on track. HBM4 competition intensifying as flagged.

**Hyperscaler AI capex (Signal 3 — bull, above baseline):** No new guide-down. Combined 2026 capex now tracking **$725–775B** vs. baseline $600-700B: Amazon ~$220B, Alphabet ~$195-205B (raised), Microsoft ~$175B, Meta raised to $130-145B. Financing: Wall Street reportedly preparing a $60B AI chip infrastructure package tied to Anthropic/AVGO ecosystem.

**AMD MI400 / Custom ASIC (Signal 4 — bull):** AMD formalized MI455X specs at *Advancing AI 2026*: CDNA5, TSMC 2nm, **432 GB HBM4, 23.3 TB/s bandwidth**; Helios rack-scale at **$5.25M** (72 × MI455X, 1.7 PB/s aggregate). Google reportedly tapping AMD to co-design next TPU. Meta announced MTIA 300/400/450/500 roadmap (with AVGO, mass deploy 2027). Custom ASIC share shift accelerating.

**Optical / Photonics (Signal 5 — bull):** Coherent (COHR) at **ECOC 2026** showcased PhotonLink platform, 3.2T transceivers, 6.4T NPO optical engines, CPO/NPO for AI scale-out. Lumentum (LITE) backlog **>$400M** with most shipping H2 2026; secured another multi-hundred-million CPO ultra-high-power laser order, shipments H1 2027. InP supply constraint story remains intact.

**Solar (Signal 6 — mixed/tariff-supported):** FSLR reaffirmed 2026 guidance ($4.9–5.2B, 17–18.2 GW). New federal **$0.38/W price floor** on modules (Presidential Proclamation 11052) + 15% tariff on polysilicon derivatives — supportive for domestic manufacturers. FSLR, ENPH, ARRY rallied on tariff protection news. AI datacenter power demand remains structural tailwind.

---

## Context vs. Baseline

Hyperscaler capex is running **above** the $600-700B baseline (now $725-775B), validating the demand side. DRAM pricing momentum is decelerating on schedule — the high-base effect will make H2 look mild vs. H1 even if absolute levels hold. The baseline correction-after-2026 HBM warning remains the key risk to monitor: capacity from all three suppliers is scaling simultaneously now, with no new denial or delay. AMD MI400 launch is ahead of baseline

timing — confirmed.

## Most Important Development

**MRVL Investor Day (Oct 6, 3 days out):** Marvell is hosting a Custom AI Investor Event on October 6 with a multi-year custom silicon revenue forecast. TAM raised to $94B by 2028, 18 XPU sockets secured, 50+ pipeline opportunities representing $75B lifetime revenue, and custom ramp expected to accelerate in H2 FY2027. This is the single most actionable near-term event for the watchlist — a beat/raise on custom silicon TAM or new hyperscaler naming could be a significant catalyst for MRVL and adjacent names (CRDO, ALAB).
